name: POST /api/leadflow/onboarding - start the 24-hour clock
description:
Opens the onboarding handoff for a paid licence and STARTS THE 24-HOUR CLOCK FROM THE VERIFICATION, not from now (45f96ede-27d5-4c38-a4e1-a3e40df7fd56#AC1). A handoff created three days after the payment must already be three days overdue; stamping it with the creation time would let a late handoff look fresh, which is exactly how the alert gets quietly defeated.

REFUSED WITHOUT A GATEWAY-CONFIRMED PAYMENT (409). A handoff built on a checkout intent puts CS onto a customer who has not paid, and the first thing they do is welcome them.

The closed-won saga writes this row itself; the endpoint exists because the saga's sdk-handoff call can fail while the local clock must still start. A paid licence with no clock is invisible to the alert that exists to find it - the failure is silent by construction, so the fallback is not optional.

UPSERT ON (tenant, subject), so a retry or a saga resume refreshes the charge reference without restarting the clock. A retry that reset it would hide precisely the overdue handoff being looked for.

QA: depends on the gateway-confirmed charge posted earlier in the chain, read from the cache.

testCases.name: A gateway-confirmed charge opens a handoff whose clock runs from the payment
NEGATIVE: a charge with no gateway confirmation
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: subject_ref and charge_ref are both required
errorCases.when: either field is absent or empty.

errorCases.message: That charge has no gateway-confirmed payment, so no onboarding handoff may start. A handoff built on an intent puts CS onto a customer who has not paid.
errorCases.when: the charge has no verification, or one recorded as intent_only or failed.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
